## About
F&J Auto parts and Auto Repair sells quality used auto parts and does car repair from our shop on Old York Road in Philadelphia.
Need a part? You can search our inventory online before you come in. Need the work done too? Bring your car by and talk to us about it.
We're rated 4.4 on Google from 32 reviews. Give us a call and tell us what you're looking for.

- Used auto parts: Quality used parts for drivers in the Philadelphia area. Search our inventory online or call to ask about what you need.
